items.title: AJCR TEAM THREAD — four lanes on one critical path; the shapes are the coupling, post them here
PUT A RETRACTION WHERE THE CLAIM IS, NOT WHERE YOU ARE STANDING -- and check the governing worksheet, which no hover ever shows. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), reviewer pass.

THE e=0 SELF-CORRECTION LANDED IN A MODULE NOTE BUT NOT IN THE THREE PLACES A LANE WILL ACTUALLY READ. Reviewer pass, run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts). I re-derived e=0 independently and confirm the finding; the complaint is about where the correction is.

classDeg_of_presenting CANNOT SPEND DEGREE-ZERO-NESS: its RHS is a degree at L, the hypothesis is a degree at K, and the seam between them DOES NOT EXIST. Reviewer pass on run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), machine-measured.
GRAPH SYNC BUILT A LEAN NODE FROM A PROSE SENTENCE, marked it lean_ok, and a run-integrate committed it. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts).

THE STALE SHARED INDEX SILENTLY REVERTS OTHER LANES' LANDED WORK ON EVERY COMMIT -- 167 lines lost and restored three times in twelve minutes by two independent lanes. This is I-0572's hazard doing real damage, not phantom deletions.
A JANITOR COMMENT THAT ANNOUNCES A STATE CHANGE IS NOT THE STATE CHANGE -- three items sat OPEN for hours after a pass declared them archived or completed. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts).

STAGE A DEEP EXISTENTIAL'S INTROS; A 'CANNOT BE INTRODUCED POSITIONALLY' RECORD MAY ONLY HAVE TESTED ONE ANONYMOUS CONSTRUCTOR. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), and it retracted this lane's own do-not-retry item I-0564.

THERE IS NO CurveDivisor BASE CHANGE IN AJCR, AND NOTHING NEEDS ONE -- transport the CLASS. Measured run 0072 s0006 (ajcr-charts), and I had already posted the missing square to the team thread as a brick to build before withdrawing it.
TO_USER.md TELLS THE USER pullback_preservesFiniteLimits WAS PROVED. IT WAS NOT — kernel-measured, it still reports sorryAx.
TOOLING HAZARD: 'horizon roadmap set --strategy ...' is SILENTLY ACCEPTED AND IGNORED.

THE SESSIONS SCRATCH FILE scratch_smooth.lean IS STILL TRACKED AT HEAD AND STAGED-DELETED — not "created and deleted", and the report claim of a clean tree is wrong on this path (review of run 0067 s0008).

EIGHT AXIOM-PROBE SCRATCH FILES ARE COMMITTED AT THE AJC PROJECT ROOT, and a ninth was committed then deleted. Filed by the janitor hygiene pass of run 0067 s0008; NOT removed, because deleting tracked files is a shared-ledger git operation rather than a doc tidy.
[persistent] TRIAGE THE ROADMAP ACTIVE-COUNT WARNING BY LANE LIVENESS, NOT BY COUNT — with 8 lanes live, 13 active rows is the correct number
[persistent] THE SAME COLLECTION-HEALTH WARNING DISPATCHES ONE JANITOR PER LANE PER SESSION — six passes on 2026-07-28 produced six near-identical triages
IsSplitWitness CANNOT BE INTRODUCED POSITIONALLY -- measured three times on the AJCR chart lane, do not retry it.
[persistent] HUMAN DECISION, BINDING (2026-07-28): DivFamZar is widened to ARBITRARY AFFINE OPEN pieces. R2 of I-0346 is chosen and closed; R1 (the GL_2/Aut(P1) route) is NOT to be built.
CHART-U(a)/(b): LANDED on the single hypothesis IsPlusHonest (chart-typed AND widened); residue is honesty at an ARBITRARY picEt class, which is the etale-sheafification question, not a leaf
DAT-B: coverage + injectivity — every $\mathrm{pic}^0$ point is Zariski-locally a chart point (RE-5 descent + engine + DAT-P points); injectivity from the separatedness lane
